|quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Creeping Frost''' is a [[projectile]] [[cold]] [[spell]] that launches a frozen skull at a targeted area. The projectile will explode when it reaches the targeted area, or if it comes into contact with an enemy. This explosion causes initial damage and creates a [[Chilling Area]] that slows and deals cold damage over time to any enemies that enter it. This chilling area will move in the direction of nearby enemies. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''[[Area of Effect]]:''' The radius of the explosion is affected by all AoE increases. Full spell damage is done to any enemy in range of the explosion. {{il|Concentrated Effect}} and ''Area of Effect damage'' passive nodes will only affect the damage if the projectile does not fork or pierce. Additionally Area of Effect chilled ground effect will only trigger at the end of a projectile chain supported by {{il|Chain Support}}. * '''[[Projectile]]:''' While {{il|Lesser Multiple Projectiles}} and {{il|Greater Multiple Projectiles}} will increase the number of projectiles, a single target can only be hit by one projectile of Creeping Frost. However, an enemy '''can''' be hit by multiple explosions from a single cast, provided each projectile can collide with something and there is enough overlap on the enemy. In this sense, Creeping Frost is capable of "shotgunning" an enemy. * '''[[Duration]]:''' Increases/decreases to duration affect length of time the chilled ground remains. Creeping Frost's chilling area is not considered [[Chilled Ground]]. Enemies affected by Creeping Frost's chilling area counts as being {{c|mod|Chilled by you}}. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Cold
